comment: Great teacher, sweet personality. It is hard not to enjoy yourself in this class.

Professor Goethals is a great teacher. He is tough (there's a pretty good amount of reading for each class) but he is a fair grader on tests and understanding of students' requests to lessen workloads. Definitely take him if you have the chance.

Excellent professor. Take him if you have the chance. Has fair tests and paper, requires a lot of reading, but listens to student concerns, and will adjust the amount of reading if need be. Brings in psychological material to reinforce whatever is being taught, and is always on topic.

Dr. Goethals is easily the greatest professor at the University of Richmond.  He is engaging, genuinely cares about his students and the subject matter, and will do anything to enhance your Jespon experience.
Great guy, good teacher, and very helpful.  Really reasonable.  Def. take him.

One of the nicest teachers I've ever met.  He is very smart and knows what he is teaching.  Professor Goethals is more than resonable with work and will help with anything.  I'm taking an introductory course with him and he has maintained my interest in the subject through the semester.  In short I would say great guy take his course.
Incredible dry sense of humor and a wealth of knowledge.  Definetely a teacher worth taking.
